doc.title: Joe Bushkin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Eddie Condon and leaders who were players
summary: Condon, Dorsey, Goodman and Berigan were instrumentalists rather than just leaders.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Oh great. How about Eddie Condon?

Oh I loved Eddie, Eddie was a barrel house, he was one of the guys in the band. The thing about Tommy Dorsey and Benny Goodman and Bunny Berigan especially, they were instrumentalists, like we were. It wasn’t like Paul Whiteman or someone up there with a fiddle under his arm who didn’t play. And that makes a big difference.
They weren’t just leaders, they were players too.
They were players. That was very important.
